### God Will Keep Your Way Secure
Author: Debbie McDaniel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-april-7.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 22:33
Points:
- Storms and hardships still happen, but God provides shelter and safety in the middle of them.
- Difficult circumstances, painful relationships, and spiritual attacks cannot overthrow God's protection.
- The Lord strengthens believers so their steps remain firm even when life feels overwhelming.
- Remembering God's presence brings inner peace and prepares believers for future service.

### Praising the Rock of My Salvation
Author: Michael Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-september-16-2024.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 22:4
Points:
- David struggled with fear and despair, yet he maintained a heart that earnestly sought God.
- God knows each person intimately and desires a personal relationship rather than a distant connection.
- The Lord acts as an anchor in life's earthquakes, shielding believers from harm and sin.
- Calling upon God for deliverance leads to genuine praise for the salvation secured in Christ.

### Day 74: 2 Samuel 22:1–51
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-74-2-samuel-22-151.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 22:7
Points:
- Reflecting on past deliverances reminds believers of God's sovereign faithfulness over decades.
- Facing new trials can revive an older faith and rekindle youthful passion for the Lord.
- Experiencing God's care throughout life replaces self-sufficiency with deep, personal dependence.
- Remembering that God hears our cries in distress moves the heart to love Him wholeheartedly.

### Kindness to the Lord’s Anointed
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/kindness-to-the-lords-anointed
Passage: 2 Samuel 22:51
Points:
- God's rewards and blessings to His servants are given by grace rather than earned merit.
- Any endurance, strength, or victory believers experience is empowered by the Lord.
- David's military triumphs point forward to Jesus Christ, who defeated death and Satan.
- While Christians still face earthly trials, God promises final deliverance to all who belong to Christ.
